additions.title: UT Southwestern STARS Summer Research Program
additions.costNote: Participants are paid a stipend; amount not published
additions.description: Eight-week, non-residential biomedical research program in a UT Southwestern lab with a faculty host. For North Texas juniors, 16+ by June 1, with no prior research experience. Students present results at the end.

additions.title: TxDOT Aviation Art Contest
additions.org: Texas Department of Transportation, Aviation Division
additions.costNote: No entry fee listed; gift-card prizes of $100/$75/$50 per age group
additions.description: Texas art contest on the theme "Texas in Flight." Age groups 6-9, 10-13 and 14-17 (high schoolers compete in 14-17). Entries must be postmarked by Feb 27, 2027 and mailed to the TxDOT Aviation Division.

additions.title: EAA Chapter 35 Air Academy Scholarship
additions.costNote: Full scholarship covers tuition, room, meals and transportation
additions.description: Full scholarship to EAA Air Academy's Explore Session for a San Antonio-area youth aged 16-17. Submit an application plus an essay (up to 800 words) or an audio/video file (up to 8 minutes) on your interest in aviation.

additions.title: Texas Aerospace Scholars (Junior Experience)
additions.deadlineNote: 2026-27 application window (Jul 1-Sep 16, 2026) has closed; next window not yet published
additions.description: Free STEM program for Texas high school juniors (U.S. citizens, Texas residents): an online course and design challenges, a virtual Moonshot week, and for top teams a residential experience at Johnson Space Center.

additions.title: Texas A&M VIZ Summer Camp
additions.org: Texas A&M University, Department of Visualization
additions.costNote: $1,400 per session including housing and meals; scholarships being explored, details not final
additions.description: Residential one-week camp for high school students ages 15-18 on animation and web/mobile app design, held June 6-11, 2027. Registration opens Feb 27 and closes May 1.

additions.title: My Introduction to Engineering (MITE)
additions.org: Cockrell School of Engineering, UT Austin
additions.costNote: $500 after acceptance; full or partial scholarships available through the application
additions.deadlineNote: Deadline not published yet; applications open Dec 1
additions.description: Five-day summer engineering camp at UT Austin for current high school juniors. Requires Algebra II (or equivalent) with a C or better; precalculus is not required. Scholarships cover full or partial cost.

additions.title: High School Research Academy (HSRA)
additions.org: College of Natural Sciences, UT Austin
additions.costNote: $4,500 tuition; limited need-based scholarships include free tuition and a stipend
additions.deadlineNote: Applications open mid-January 2027; deadline in March 2027 (exact date not published)
additions.description: Five-week, in-person research placement in a UT Austin lab, June 7 to July 14, 2027. Must be 15+ by June 1, 2027. Texas residents prioritized; rising juniors and seniors preferred. Housing and transportation not provided.
